notes_list.title: Price Reduction and Extra Quantity
notes_list.basic_overview: Reduced price per kg = (total spend x reduction %) / extra quantity.
notes_list.extra_info_content: Rice: (640 x 20%) / 6.4 = 128 / 6.4 = Rs 20 per kg after the reduction.

notes_list.title: Profit and Loss Chain (bike)
notes_list.basic_overview: P sells for Rs 90,000 at 20% loss, so CP of P = 90,000/0.8 = 1,12,500. A 10% profit on this = 1,23,750 (Q's selling price to R).

notes_list.title: Partnership with Changed Investment
notes_list.basic_overview: Ratios 4/3 : 5/2 : 6/7 become 56 : 105 : 36 (LCM 42). B raises 105 by 40% to 147 after 3 months.

notes_list.title: Compound Interest, Compounded Every 4 Months
notes_list.basic_overview: 60% per year compounded every 4 months means 20% per period for 3 periods.

notes_list.title: Instalments with Simple Interest (scooter)
notes_list.basic_overview: Balance after down payment = 65,000 - 41,000 = 24,000. With 25% p.a. simple interest for 5 months, amount due = 24,000 x (1 + 25x5/1200) = 26,500.
notes_list.extra_info_content: Each instalment x earns interest on the later months: 5x + x(25/1200)(4+3+2+1) = 26,500, so 5.2083x = 26,500 and x = about Rs 5,088. (Answer worked out here: the PDF has only the question. It matches option 5,088.)

notes_list.title: Ages: Equations from Averages
notes_list.basic_overview: Raman + Suman + Mohan = 3 x 34 = 102. 3 Suman = 2 Raman gives Raman = 1.5 Suman.
notes_list.extra_info_content: Using 5(Mohan - 7) = 4(Suman - 5) with Mohan = 102 - 2.5 Suman, we get Suman = 30, so five years hence he will be 35.

notes_list.title: Boat and River
notes_list.basic_overview: Upstream speed = distance / time; downstream speed likewise; stream speed = (downstream - upstream) / 2.
notes_list.extra_info_content: Upstream 4 km in 5 h = 0.8 km/h; downstream 16 km in 5 h = 3.2 km/h; stream = (3.2 - 0.8)/2 = 1.2 km/h.

notes_list.title: Two Numbers: Sum and Sum of Cubes
notes_list.extra_info_content: Sum 15, sum of cubes 1755: 1755 = 3375 - 45ab so ab = 36; (a-b)^2 = 225 - 144 = 81, so the difference is 9.

notes_list.title: Median of 10 Observations
notes_list.basic_overview: Arrange in order; if n is even, median = average of the (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms.
